versions.changelog:
- Skill renamed from haixian-ppt-skill to guizang-ppt-skill.
- Now generates horizontal swipe web-based PPTs as single HTML files with WebGL backgrounds, section covers, data posters, image grids, etc.
- Offers two distinct visual styles: Magazine × E-Ink (serif, warm, fluid) and Swiss Internationalism (sans-serif, grid, high-contrast accents).
- Provides detailed workflow for requirements clarification, layout choices, theme selection (from 5 curated palettes), and image/screenshot handling.
- Strict instructions and conventions ensure consistent aesthetics, file structure, and usability for sharing, demo, or publishing scenarios.
